# Fashion Closet Skill for Muse

A Markdown-based wardrobe-memory system treated as reflection loop, not shopping bot: it catalogs your pieces with immutable IDs (intake from photos, labels, and facts), plans outfits from what you own — body-, weather-, and occasion-aware — logs what you wore with verdicts and lessons, and triages active/sleeping/undecided/retired items without erasing their emotional meaning. Principles are explicit: reuse before buying, push back on weak fabric/fit claims, no body or taste shaming. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this needs an initial setup from you — a configured closet folder with inventory files the skill operates on — and it stays inside that folder; it will not build you a web app or act as a generic recommendation engine. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
